sentences.text:
By way of the present petition, the petitioner seeks quashing of FIR bearing no. 168/2018,
registered at Police Station Nangloi, Delhi for the commission of offence punishable under Section 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC').
The learned ASC accepts notice on behalf of the State.
3. The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner seeks time to place Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on record.

Let the same be placed, at least two days prior to the next date of hearing.
4. List on 03.03.2026.
5.
The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
DR. SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J JANUARY 29, 2026/
